notes.title: 1.1.15b update
notes.content:
Small fixes to improve the current 1.1.15 version.

1.1.15b:
- Fixed "Jumps" stat always showing 0 in non-singleplayer modes
- Changed "Ok" button in Server Disconnected/Not compatible version to a more visible color
- Added "Motion Blur" setting in Video Settings
- Fixed Discord integration dependency, making the game not work when Discord was not present

notes.title: Small fix :)
